canonical_retention.composition: GameSoundRuntime::Impl binds samples and resources to the same current_owner/current_cache publications, library, services.strings, words.resource_bytes and writable null bytes. Its instance and retained-shutdown contexts already borrow this same samples object.
canonical_retention.cache_creation: Startup creates/registers the canonical auxiliary owner, stamps D5B460 and constructs its map; shared lifetime global_00f8bbe8 identifies that cache. The manager is moved after the cache for the existing shutdown schedule.

canonical_retention.lifetime: Retain the SAME core/sample runtime, current cache publication and live cache, strings, current sound owner/resource owner, resource runtime, FMOD library/handles, accounting/null words and associated service domain through the last GlobalConfig sample release. No substitute cache/runtime/CRT string pool is acceptable.
canonical_retention.shutdown: GameSoundRuntime header requires external sample/channel references released before shutdown. shutdown destroys manager then cache; samples() remaining callable as a C++ accessor does not make destroyed publications/resources usable. Manager ordering relative to GlobalConfig must be established by full application wiring.

suggested_adapter_contract.status: Design readiness only; no Source implementation authorized or added.
suggested_adapter_contract.binding: Borrow exactly the proven canonical SoundSampleRuntime and the existing NativeGlobalConfigCurrentDispatch for independently admitted raw payloads. Retain both through GlobalConfig drain.

Re-read the current dispatch state for the actual passed object; no cached table/identity, extra decrement, new retain, slot clear or post-call object access.
suggested_adapter_contract.admission: The containing domain must establish that every pointer routed by numeric D5B074 is the complete base of a valid 0x7C sample returned by this exact canonical factory/cache and still owned under this runtime. The numeric check alone is insufficient; this is not a general arbitrary-pointer adapter or a new claim that cache membership proves ownership.
suggested_adapter_contract.stop: Always preserve a genuine fresh current-table+8 call for an admitted non-null second-domain object, with the unmodified flag. Never route a sample through stop, synthesize a sample stop, drop the callback or assume the second array is empty.
suggested_adapter_contract.unknowns: A foreign/unknown numeric stamp is not automatically a raw callable table. Unknown producer/domain admission stays open. Indices >=3 of the unchecked ObjectiveSounds assignment can place sample pointers into stop-bearing slots; that input is not made compatible by a sample zero adapter.
suggested_adapter_contract.noexcept: GlobalConfigEffects methods and aggregate are noexcept, while existing sample runtime/scalar helpers can throw. Use requires a concrete nonthrowing valid-service domain; neither suppressed exceptions nor general native EH/SEH equivalence is supplied.

          resources(system, current_owner, words.resource_bytes_00f8bbe4, services.mounts,
              services.registrations, services.load_events, library, services.strings),

          instance{current_owner, words.next_id_00f8bbd4, services.strings, samples, library, bank_virtuals},
